facts.fact: 今日拍卖图录 Lot 3 为 King Penguin 丛书第 74 种《Woodland Birds》（1955 年伦敦首版），扉页内衬贴有「Miriam Bramley」的藏书票。
facts.anchor: Ownership bookplate – ‘Miriam Bramley’ – to front pastedown.

facts.fact: Alf 报信：Caswell 家的小儿子（Lawrence）在树丛里举着望远镜观鸟，两人的镜头隔着树相接。
facts.anchor: ‘Caswell the younger is only a twitcher! I’m not joking. Our lenses locked through the trees.’

facts.fact: Alf 转述 Lawrence 打听 Pamela：想知道她昨天之后是否安好、有没有再「发作」一次。
facts.anchor: ‘Wanted to know you were okay after yesterday. Hadn’t had another turn.’

facts.fact: Alf 转达邀约：Lawrence 想请他们明晚去游泳，同行的还有 Nancy。
facts.anchor: ‘In fact, he wants us to swim tomorrow evening.’ He paused, enjoying our hungry anticipation, raised an eyebrow. ‘With him and Nancy.’

facts.fact: Alf 把自己的鸟类图鉴借给了 Lawrence，理由是不想让 Pamela 欠他人情。
facts.anchor: ‘I didn’t want you to be in his debt, Pammy, okay?’

facts.fact: Pa 警告：Celia 视 Lawrence 为掌上明珠、不愿他被「分心」（by Pamela 没说出口）；Lawrence 已内定接手家族生意、一桩体面婚事与远大前程。
facts.anchor: ‘Celia won’t like it.’ He scratched his neck, lifted his chin. ‘That boy’s the apple of her eye, Miriam. I get the impression she’ll not want him … distracted.’ He didn’t say ‘by Pamela’, but it hung there in the thick air. ‘He’s earmarked for the family business. A fancy marriage. Great things.’

facts.fact: 母亲在菜园对 Miriam 放行，让她趁还能去的时候去树林看金翅雀。
facts.anchor: ‘You go to those goldfinches, Miriam.’ She nodded towards the woods. ‘While you can, love.’

facts.fact: 结尾 Miriam 在铜色山毛榉下顿悟：Lawrence 根本不是在观鸟，他在找 Pamela，正如她在找他。
facts.anchor: Lawrence hadn’t been bird-spotting, of course. He’d been searching for Pamela, just as I was for him.
